title: Union Minister Jyotiraditya M. Scindia Interacts with Students at Mizoram University
subtitle:
Shri Scindia Highlights Northeast’s Rich Cultural Heritage and Development Potential
MDoNER’s Ashtalakshmi Darshan Programme Engages Over 590 Students
body_text:
Union Minister for Communications and Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER), Shri Jyotiraditya M. Scindia, interacted with students at Mizoram University on Monday during his two-day visit to Mizoram. He also engaged with students from Goa and Chandigarh visiting the Northeast under the Ministry of DoNER’s Ashtalakshmi Darshan Programme, discussing their experiences and perspectives.
Addressing the students, Shri Scindia highlighted the Northeast’s rich cultural heritage, traditions and development potential. He emphasised that such exchanges help young people understand the region better while strengthening cultural ties, mutual understanding and national integration.
Inspired by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s vision of developing the eight northeastern states as the nation’s Ashtalakshmi, the programme provides students from across India an opportunity to experience the region’s cultural diversity and development opportunities firsthand.
Over 590 students have participated in the Ashtalakshmi Darshan Programme in the past year, fostering stronger connections between the Northeast and the rest of the country.
Shri Scindia further emphasised that the initiative aligns with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047, encouraging youth engagement, celebrating India's diversity and strengthening the Northeast’s role in the country's development journey.
The interaction reaffirmed the Ministry of DoNER’s commitment to fostering youth engagement, promoting cultural exchange and strengthening people-to-people connections, while inspiring young minds to contribute to a more connected and developed India.
